title: The Spirit and Creation
sourceBasis: World English Bible — 66-book Old and New Testament Scripture text already installed in Iron Sharpener
definition: The Spirit and creation teaches that the Holy Spirit is active in God’s work of creating, giving life, sustaining creation, and bringing order according to God’s purpose.
summary: The Spirit and creation teaches that the Holy Spirit is active in God’s work of creating, giving life, sustaining creation, and bringing order according to God’s purpose.
christFocus: The same Spirit who is active in creation is also involved in the new creation accomplished through Christ. The Spirit who gives natural life also gives spiritual life through the risen Lord.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
The Bible presents creation as the work of God, and the Spirit is present in that work. The Spirit of God hovered over the waters, and life itself is tied to the breath and power of God.

The Spirit’s work in creation shows that He is not limited to inward feelings or later church experience. He is involved in life, order, beauty, and the sustaining care of God over what He has made.

Creation depends on God continually. When God sends forth His Spirit, life is given and renewed. The world is not self-sustaining, and human life is not accidental or independent from God.

This doctrine also points toward new creation. The Spirit who gives life to creation is the Spirit who raised Christ from the dead and will give life to the mortal bodies of God’s people.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content:
People often think of the Holy Spirit only in terms of emotion or church experience. Scripture gives a larger view: the Spirit is active in God’s creative and life-giving work from the beginning.

This gives dignity to human life and hope for renewal. The Spirit of God is able to bring life, order, and restoration where there was emptiness, weakness, and death.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: See your life and breath as gifts from God. Worship the Spirit as the giver and sustainer of life, and trust Him not only for spiritual moments but for daily dependence. Let creation and new creation lead you to praise the God who gives life through His Spirit.
